short_window_plan_clarifications.rotation_rates: omega/alpha are instantaneous current body rates; historic body angular velocity uses Jr(xi)*(omega+alpha*tau), not constant physical angular acceleration over the full window.
short_window_plan_clarifications.uncertainty: Do not reuse EKF covariance. Proposed engineering window approximation: data information Jdata^T W Jdata plus fixed prior curvature Lambda; map its inverse through current model-point Jacobian. Ill-conditioned/non-finite means unavailable. Regularization does not establish data identifiability or calibrated probability.
short_window_plan_clarifications.derivative_gate: Retain pixel/age/warmup conditions; validate window uncertainty and position standard-deviation threshold with known-noise/motion before inheriting 0.1m. Report data weak directions and prior contribution.
short_window_plan_clarifications.overlap: Previous solution is warm start only; each window pixel counted once in that objective; overlapping outputs are correlated, not independent observations.
